AI Leaders Pledge Safety Commitments with President Trump

Several leading artificial intelligence (AI) developers met with President Trump at the White House and signed a pledge to prioritize AI safety. The details and effectiveness of this pledge in preventing potential risks, including human extinction, were discussed.
